verdict.rationale: GitCafe has an API reference page whose description is also offered as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON [gitcafe-docs-14]. The `cafe api <path>` command can send authenticated requests to any REST endpoint [gitcafe-docs-13], which lets users run calls from the terminal but is not an in-docs interactive explorer. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths [gitcafe-probe-3], so the spec's location is unverified, though the docs never name a path, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an interactive browser-based API explorer or try-it console, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a verified public OpenAPI spec URL, and independent corroboration.
